baseline_v1_compatibility.label_rule: Handwritten fixture ground truth: a file is relevant only when its code or documentation directly contains the implementation, declaration, or call site needed by the query. Symbol labels are repository-relative path plus exact qualified name. Empty labels mean the fixture contains no sufficient evidence.

metric_notes.candidate_scope: Lexical and vector use the same indexed chunk corpus and file-path labels; exact symbols use symbol records and path-plus-qualified-name labels.
metric_notes.empty_ground_truth: Excluded from recall/MRR; reported separately as no-evidence checks.
metric_notes.mrr: Macro mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant result; an unreturned relevant item contributes zero.

query_units.rrf: repository-relative file path fused across available lexical, symbol and vector ranks
query_units.symbols: repository-relative file path plus qualified symbol name

metric_notes.recall_at: Macro-average per query: relevant returned among the first K divided by the number of manually labelled relevant items.
metric_notes.symbol_scope: Natural-language semantic queries without exact symbol filters are not applicable to the current exact symbol API.

vector_abstention.calibration_warning: Too few evidence/no-evidence examples for a production threshold; do not select or deploy one.
vector_abstention.decision_rule: accept when top cosine similarity is greater than or equal to threshold

calibration.selection_protocol: Calibration only: require zero false accepts, maximize coverage, then minimize false rejects; prefer the simpler top-score rule on exact ties. Validation is not consulted.

limitations: Labels are provisional AI evidence review, not human reviewed.
The selected abstention rule is exploratory and is not enabled in any retriever.
RRF quality and abstention are separate questions; fusion does not prove evidence sufficiency.

provisional_benchmark.label_rule: Provisional AI evidence labels derived only from the frozen synthetic corpus. These labels are not human reviewed and cannot authorize a production abstention threshold.
